intent: Going incognito. Light: the glasses are pushed up and, a beat later, both lenses darken into shades with a highlight (left, then right), hold while the glasses drop back and settle, then clear. Strong: a dip, a higher push and a second sly lift (a double eyebrow raise) while the shades darken and stay dark longer before they clear. The highlight keeps each lens open, as the set's native-opening rule requires.

shade-l.//: hidden at rest: the dark lens fills the rim only while the glasses are in disguise; its highlight (a 45-degree streak 2 wide, upper left) is a real counter, so each lens keeps an opening at 32 px (set 26 rule)

shade-r.//: drawn, not mirrored, so both highlights sit upper left like one light source
